description: Audits an investor relations, announcement or token issuer page for AI search engines and agents: which AI crawlers robots.txt lets in (ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Google, Bing/Copilot, Claude), llms.txt, text without JavaScript, title and description, schema.org issuer markup, and corporate action notices in the open format (iomarkets.org/formats) checked against the SEC filings. With a subject, also grades the page's own figures against the feed. Returns each check (pass, warn, fail) with its fix, plus the JSON-LD, llms.txt and robots.txt lines to paste. Reads the page, robots.txt and llms.txt; stores nothing. Same code as https://iomarkets.tech/ai-readiness.

subject.description: The company, fund or token it is about: ticker, name, token symbol or ISIN (optional).

name: audit_ai_readiness
title: Can AI engines read this issuer page?
